story.value: The name tin comes from the Anglo-Saxon word tin, and its origin is unknown.
The symbol Sn comes from the Latin word stannum, which was used for alloys containing lead.
Tin was known in prehistoric times.

uses.value: Tin resists corrosion and is used as a protective coating on other metals.
Tin and lead are mixed together to make pewter and solder.
A tin compound called stannous fluoride is used in some types of toothpaste.
